description: Configure the 'example-repo-local' repository to block the deployment of snapshot artifacts. Log in to Artifactory (admin/password) if needed. Navigate to Administration > Repositories > Local > example-repo-local. In the Basic (or Advanced) settings tab, locate the 'Excludes Pattern' field. Add a pattern to exclude any file containing 'SNAPSHOT' (case-insensitive) in its name (e.g., '**/*SNAPSHOT*'). Save the repository configuration. Verify that you cannot deploy a file named 'app-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar' but can deploy 'app-1.0.jar'.
